description: Upcoming BJJ and grappling competitions from federation and organizer calendars (IBJJF, AJP, Smoothcomp and others), by country and date range. Returns at most 10 per call with the link to the organizer for registration, plus the BJJ Square calendar page for the full list.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Omit for worldwide.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today; past dates are moved to today.

lang.description: Language of the returned bjjsquare.com links: it, en, es, pt, fr or de. Default en.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Default from + 90 days, max from + 366 days.

name: find_competitions
title: Find upcoming BJJ competitions
